description: §13.9.1 S475 rule 3: a locked pending cell whose initializer reads cells is a derived cell and stays E-VALUE-SERVER-CALL — and it reads a cell when a called function does (`cur()` reads `@userId`).
rationale: §13.9.1 rule 3: "locked + an initializer that reads cells is a derived cell (§66.9 rule 3) and stays refused, E-VALUE-SERVER-CALL"; the initializer "reads cells" when it reads a cell directly or through a called function. ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S475 "⭐ RULED — S475 owner questions, PA recs adopted wholesale" items 1 and 7.
